segments.he: אִשָּׁה שֶׁהִיא מְרֻבָּה בְּדָמִים, הִיא דַּבְּרָנִית; וְאַל תִּתְיַפֶּה בְּעֵינֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם, גַּם תִּרְחַץ אֶת עַצְמָהּ בְּמֵי מַעֲיָנוֹת, גַּם אַל תְּיַגַע אֶת עַצְמָהּ הַרְבֵּה, גַּם בַּעֲלָהּ יִזָּהֵר בִּנְטִילַת־יָדַיִם, גַּם אַל תִּכְעַס, גַּם אַחַר הַטְּבִילָה תִּתֵּן צְדָקָה. גַּם בַּעְלָהּ יִלְמַד מַסֶּכֶת נִדָּה וְאַחַר־כָּךְ יֹאמַר שִׁיר שֶׁל יוֹם. גַּם תִּרְחַץ אֶת עַצְמָהּ בִּדְבָרִים הָעוֹלִים מִתּוֹךְ הַמְּצוּדָה מִן הַנָּהָר, גַּם תִּשְׁתֶּה חֲלַב עֵז, גַּם תִּרְחַץ בְּנוֹצַת עִזִּים, גַּם תְּעַשֵּׁן אֶת עַצְמָהּ בִּלְבוֹנָה.

segments.en: 1. A woman who bleeds abundantly is an excessive talker. She should not beautify herself in people's eyes, also she should wash in spring water, also she should not exert herself excessively. Also, her husband should be careful with ritual hand washing. Also, she should not get angry. Also, after her immersion she should give charity. Also her husband should learn the tractate Nidah (Menstrual Impurity), and afterwards recite the Song for the Day (every day of the week has a different Psalm). Also, she should wash herself with things that can be raised from nets in the river. Also, she should drink goats' milk. Also, she should wash herself using goat feathers, and smoke herself in frankincense.

segments.he: אִשָּׁה שֶׁשּׁוֹפַעַת דָּם, תִּכְתֹּב אוֹתִיּוֹת "לֹא אֶחָד" וְתִשָּׂא עָלֶיהָ.

segments.en: 2. A woman who is oozing blood should write the letters lo echad (not one), and carry it on her.

segments.he: אִשָּׁה שֶׁהִיא פְּרוּצָה, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה אֵין לָהּ וֶסֶת וּמַרְבָּה בְּדָמִים.

segments.en: 3. A woman who is immodest, through this she does not have a set time for her period and bleeds abundantly.

segments.he: נִדָּה שֶׁרָאֲתָה דָּם דֶּרֶךְ מִקְרֶה הוּא מֵחֲמַת חֵטְא הָאִיש.

segments.en: 4. A woman in her time of impurity, who saw blood by chance, it is because of a sin of the husband.
1. A woman who does not have a period should fast.

segments.he: סְגֻלָּה לְהַחֲזִיר לְאִשָּׁה וֶסְתָּהּ עַל־יְדֵי הַכְנָסַת־ אוֹרְחִים.
segments.he_nikud: סְגֻלָּה לְהַחֲזִיר לְאִשָּׁה וֶסְתָּהּ עַל־יְדֵי הַכְנָסַת־ אוֹרְחִים.
segments.en: 2. A segulah (conducive) to restore to a woman her period, is through hospitality.

segments.he: מִי שֶׁעִסְקוֹ וּמַשָּׂאוֹ־וּמַתָּנוֹ עִם הָאֻמּוֹת בְּעֵת חַגָּם אוֹ אֲפִלּוּ שֶׁלֹּא בְּעֵת חַגָּם, אֶלָּא שֶׁפַּרְנָסָתוֹ שֶׁמַּעֲמִיד דְּבָרִים לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה שֶׁלָּהֶם, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה אִשְׁתּוֹ שׁוֹפַעַת דָּם תֵּכֶף סָמוּךְ לִטְבִילָתָהּ.

segments.en: 3. One whose business and dealings are with the non-Jewish nations at the time of their festivals -- or even not at that time, but he derives an income from supplying them with articles to be used for their idol worship -- through this, his wife bleeds immediately following her immersion.
